title: Read next's staged delivery page and its session row from one commit
outcome: Read next's staged delivery page and its session row from one commit
acceptance: A test commits a confirmation or re-stage between the session read and the payload read and shows the fixed behavior, and the test fails without the fix; the full quality gates pass

When a pending staged page exists, work_next reads the session row, the staged payload and the page verification from one commit. If another process with the same session confirms or re-stages the page in between, next then either returns the page it read or stages afresh; it never reports 'pending work delivery has no exact staged payload' or a staged-page verification error for that race

completion.summary: next's staged-delivery read now takes the session row, the staged payload and the page check from one snapshot (delivery_state). The implicit confirmation of the previous page is one UPDATE (confirm_pending_work_session_delivery). Race tests use the shared concurrent_commit harness: confirm, re-stage, confirm-past and a focus change, each committed mid-read. Each fails with its false error under the old code. Committed as 7c1ba5d, with the comment fix in 91c8140. An independent evaluation passed both criteria.
